title: Stock Footage of Korea, Seoul, Korea (1969, colour)
year: 1969 (catalog coverage 21 Sep – 2 Nov 1969; slate dated 7 Nov 69)
producer: U.S. Navy (Pacific Fleet Combat Camera Group; slate 'T.K. Reynolds, Stock footage Seoul, ROK')
licence: Public domain: US federal government work: filmed by US military personnel as part of their official duties, so under 17 U.S.C. § 105 it is not protected by copyright in the US (public domain). In Korea it is also out of term: the Korean Copyright Act protects films for 70 years from publication, and this footage is from 1969.
licence_notes: NARA lists use restriction as 'Undetermined' (no copyright flag). This is U.S. Navy combat-camera footage, so it is a federal work.
kogl_type: N/A (US federal work, not a Korean 공공저작물)
attribution_required: Not legally required for public-domain works, but recommended (and good practice for the channel):
attribution_text: 영상 출처: 미국 국립문서기록관리청(NARA) 428-NPC-43612 (NAID 87540) / Source: U.S. National Archives, 428-NPC-43612 (NAID 87540)
contents: Downtown Seoul in colour, autumn 1969. Traffic lights, new high-rise blocks, and late-60s sedans, buses and a cement mixer crossing a wide boulevard. An office building with a zig-zag fire escape. The plaza in front of Seoul City Hall with its clock tower and buses. The domed Seoul City Hall (서울시청) with taegukgi flying and a large banner reading '우리의 단결만이 … 있다', and people walking up the steps. The source is 720x480 with no aspect flag and was re-encoded as 4:3 (640x480). Silent.
